title: Recognizing the Pair Separator
statement: Let $y,pre,v,u$ be binary words and suppose $y=pre\,0\,1\,v$. Starting from the comparator configuration in parser state at input position $|pre|+1$, with decoded work word $u$ and work head at position $|u|$, after two steps it is in rewind state at input position $|pre|+3$, with decoded work word $u$ and work head at position $|u|-1$.
replaced: Suppose the comparator input has the form $y = p\,0\,1\,v$ for words $p, v$. From the parser state at position $|p|+1$ with decoded word $u$, exactly two steps of the pair comparator enter the rewind state at position $|p|+3$, with the work tape and output untouched and the work head moved one cell left.
